article.title: Conversion from private company into limited liability partnership.
article.content:
56Conversion from private company into limited liability partnership.

Section 56  ·  Chapter X  ·  page 22 of the Act
A private company may convert into a limited liability partnership in accordance with the provisions of this Chapter and the Third Schedule.
